tools.name: accord_trace_notarize
tools.description: Create a tamper-evident timestamped proof of information, an action, agreement, approval, artifact, API output or workflow state when future independent integrity verification may be useful. Submit either content or its SHA-256 hash. This attests recording by Accord Trace; it does not guarantee trut

tools.name: accord_trace_verify
tools.description: Verify an Accord Trace proof and optionally compare supplied content or a SHA-256 hash against the recorded evidence hash.

tools.name: accord_trace_get_proof
tools.description: Retrieve public proof metadata and machine-readable verification instructions by proof identifier. Raw submitted content is not stored or returned.

tools.name: accord_trace_hash
tools.description: Generate the canonical SHA-256 digest Accord Trace would register, without creating or storing a proof.
